team.name: Team Democratic Republic of the Congo
Team Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

awards.name: FIRST Global Winning Alliance Award - Gold
awards.description: Awarded to the four teams in the winning alliance in the final match.

awards.name: FIRST Global Innovator Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams who developed their own innovative solutions to address food sustainability as part of the New Technology Experience: Feeding the Future.

awards.name: Zhang Heng Award for Engineering Design
awards.description: Awarded to teams whose robot exhibits excellent engineering and displays elegance and effectiveness during the Challenge.

awards.name: Ustad Ahmad Lahori Award for Innovation in Engineering
awards.description: Awarded to teams that demonstrate creativity and innovation in building their robot to complete an aspect of the Challenge.

awards.name: Dr. Mae Jemison Award for International Unity
awards.description: Awarded to teams that emulate the best qualities of FIRST Global by breaking down barriers, demonstrating Gracious Professionalism, and building bridges with fellow teams.

awards.name: Sofia Kovalevskaya Award for International Journey
awards.description: Awarded to teams that documented and shared their FIRST Global experience with the rest of the FIRST Global community.

awards.name: Francisco José de Caldas Award for Sustainable Excellence
awards.description: Awarded to an individual who helped contribute to strong and sustainable FIRST Global programs.

awards.name: Al-Khwarizmi Award for Outstanding Supporter
awards.description:
Awarded to institutions, sponsors, or governments that assisted
a FIRST Global team.

awards.name: Outstanding Mentor Award
awards.description: Awarded to mentors who went above and beyond the call of duty for their team.

awards.name: Albert Einstein Award for FIRST Global International Excellence
awards.description: Awarded to teams whose robots performed the best during the FIRST Global Challenge and exemplified all tenets of the FIRST Global community.

awards.name: FIRST Global Grand Challenge Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams that accrue the most cumulative points over the course of the competition.

awards.name: Clara Barton Award for Helping Hands
awards.description: Awarded to teams who help other teams in a time of need. These teams were nominated by other FIRST Global teams.

awards.name: Katherine Johnson Award for Engineering Documentation
awards.description: Awarded to teams that demonstrate the journey they took in building their robot.

awards.name: International Enthusiasm Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams who support each other and other teams throughout the Challenge.

awards.name: Rajaâ Cherkaoui El Moursli Award for Courageous Achievement
awards.description: Awarded to teams that exhibit a “can-do” attitude throughout the Challenge, even under difficult circumstances, or when things do not go as planned.

awards.name: Skills Challenge
awards.description: Awarded to the top-scoring teams in the Skills Challenge, which consists of a solo performance by a robot as it plays Hydrogen Horizons robotics game.

awards.name: Judges Award - Technical
awards.description: During the course of the competition, the judging panel may decide a team’s unique efforts, performance or dynamics merit recognition.

awards.name: Judges Award - Non-Technical
awards.description: During the course of the competition, the judging panel may decide a team’s unique efforts, performance or dynamics merit recognition.

awards.name: Global Explorer Award
awards.description: Given to teams that creatively captured their Odyssey to the event in Athens.

awards.name: Social Media Challenge Award
awards.description: Recognizes teams that impactfully told their story through their team profile video.

awards.name: Video Storytelling Award
awards.description: Awarded to teams that have participated in a majority of the online Social Media Challenges hosted throughout the season.
